publications.title: Music Toolkits: Custom Tracks & Portable Editors
notes: OGG, CSEQ and Model Importer now share the game installation configured in Launcher Settings.
OGG detects Hangout level_99 plus native custom Track mods.
CSEQ lists custom tracks and adds a visible Game Folder selector on every tab.
CF:R logo and taskbar icons restored across music editors.
OGG opens without a PowerShell console; all tools are standalone Windows EXEs.
Portable ZIP tests cover editor startup, game path and native mod discovery.

publications.title: Forge Hub Accounts & Multi-Monitor Fixes
notes: Forge Hub login: GitHub website sign-in or username/email and password, plus new-account registration.
Secure connection of existing Forge Hub accounts with one-time browser approval.
Profile widget with GitHub avatar, online status, and illustrated Guest fallback.
Context-specific orange account popup; duplicate ACCOUNT shortcut removed.
Fixed account windows freezing launcher mouse, keyboard or Close.
Popup follows the launcher on multiple monitors.
Fit to Window stays on monitor 2 and restores original geometry.
Portable Windows ZIP needs no installed Python; updater and editors remain bundled.

publications.title: Mod folder separation
notes: New mod directory system.
Custom track detection in OGG and CSEQ Toolkits.

publications.title: File verification system
notes: File verification system.

publications.title: Forge Hub Mod Manager
notes: Forge Hub now manages online and installed mods with search, categories, sorting, Installed Only and Hide Local.
Install or update verified ZIPs into individual assets/mods/<web-id> folders, each with native enabled metadata and a permanent ID.
Enable/Disable works on the game's native INI; old local mod folders remain available without forced migrations.
Modpacks install separately identified modules with backup/rollback, and keep each mod's own character, kart, wheels or track INI.
Model Importer, CSEQ/MIDI Toolkit and OGG Toolkit are bundled as Windows EXEs with the launcher and updater.
The native game loader has a separate candidate update for flat-ID modular mods; custom native track selection remains in development.

publications.title: Model Importer v1.8 — Redesigned
notes: Model Importer v1.8: completely reorganized into a clearer Home screen with dedicated CHARACTER, KART, WHEELS and TRACKS sections.
Modular karts and wheels: improved OBJ workflows, editable offsets and four-wheel attachment positions, with optional kart color palettes that reuse the model instead of duplicating it.
Native track packages: import matching .LEV + .VRM files into separate packages without overwriting retail tracks; game-side custom track selection is still in development.
Crash Forge visual style: garage artwork and the taskbar icon are included in the bundled editor executable.
Single launcher update: the revamped editor installs and updates automatically with the Windows launcher. No separate downloads or changes to installed game mods.
Forge Hub remains live: the previous v0.3.37 announcement and its website shortcut remain available. More information is available in NEWS.

publications.title: Forge Hub Website Is Live
notes: Forge Hub website now available: browse community mods, modpacks, creators and mod categories from the website.
One-click website access: FORGE HUB now appears in the launcher header beside EDITOR and opens the official Forge Hub website.
Creator Studio: creators can submit or update their own mods and modpacks with metadata, pending moderator approval.
Moderation tools: verified moderators review releases, withdraw public listings and remove private ZIPs with a recorded reason. Creators are shown deletion notices and can dismiss them.
Game integration disclaimer: native .LEV/.VRM packages are supported for preparation, but adding custom tracks to the in-game track roster remains in development.
Windows launcher: keeps the bundled Model Importer, launcher updater, existing installed game files and user mods untouched.

publications.title: Model Importer Bundled Again
notes: Model Importer v1.7 is bundled again with the Windows launcher and updated automatically through the verified launcher updater.
Retains the actual Model Importer illustration on Home, short version highlights, and detailed NEWS.
Forge Hub moderation now allows optional Rights Evidence / review notes (maximum 1000 characters). Moderator access and explicit rights confirmation remain mandatory.
Original Crash Cove, game binaries, user mods, and update rollback behavior unchanged.

publications.title: Featured Home Artwork
notes: Home showcase: the latest update is illustrated with the real Model Importer screenshot.
Quick release highlights: current launcher version and a concise summary are visible on Home.
Full news below: open NEWS for more detailed changes and matching artwork.
Optional Model Importer: it is no longer included in the launcher ZIP. Click INSTALL TOOL to download it only when wanted.
SHA-256 verification: Model Importer downloads separately from the official GitHub release and is verified before installation.
OPEN TOOL / UPDATE TOOL: installed tools remain available, with optional updates when a new launcher release is available.
Same Windows updater, mods, native LEV/VRM track importer and Crash Cove behavior as before.

publications.title: Native Track Importer Improvements
notes: Editor > Model Importer card now clearly displays CHARACTERS / KARTS / TRACKS.
Updated tool description: import characters, customize karts and package native .LEV/.VRM track files.
Model Importer v1.7 keeps its native LEV/VRM track staging workflow; OBJ is not used for track packages.
Original Crash Cove remains untouched. Game-side custom track registration and selection remain a separate development task.
Preserves launcher auto-updater, Modpacks and the large garage-backed NEWS artwork.

publications.title: LEV / VRM Track Packages
notes: Crash Forge Model Importer v1.7: NEW native CTR track packager for paired .LEV and .VRM files; OBJ track support deliberately disabled.
Verify native file structure and SHA-256, preserve original retail levels, and back up older same-ID track packages before replacement.
Model Importer ships with the launcher under EDITOR > MODEL IMPORTER, so future tool improvements update through the verified launcher auto-updater.
Assembly Lane's legacy Crash Cove takeover is retired in the local game build; Crash Cove stays original. This game fix is separate from the launcher release.
Track package import is preparation only; game-side custom track registration/selection is still required for playability.
Previous v0.3.32 large NEWS cover and UI are preserved.

publications.title: Kart Color Variants
notes: Model Importer v1.6 now ships inside the Windows launcher and opens from EDITOR.
New kart color palette importer: one OBJ, alternate textures, independent .ini variants without duplicating Blue.
Future bundled Model Importer updates arrive automatically through launcher updates.
Redesigned NEWS: large garage artwork and concise release highlights at the front.
Preserves the verified self-updater, rollback, Modpacks, gameplay paths and Windows EXE restart.

publications.title: Forge Hub Modpacks
notes: NEW: Modpacks in Forge Hub. One verified ZIP can install characters, karts, wheels and tracks in their own folders, preserving each mod's .ini.
Modpack installs include preflight validation, backups and rollback if anything fails.
PLAY and GAME UPDATE have clearer orange/grey emphasis; the large UPDATE button stays under PLAY.
Cleaner Settings with the independent launcher auto-updater and no duplicate game-update controls.
Branded English PLAY ANYWAY / CANCEL warning when a newer verified game version is available.
Background original CTR-U (USA) file check logs results without blocking offline play.
Launcher updates automatically restart the updated .exe after closing the running launcher.

publications.title: Windows Auto-Updater
notes: Windows EXE with no console window.
Automatic launcher updates with SHA-256 verification.
Automatic restart as EXE after a successful update.
One-time migration from BAT to EXE.
Better protection for settings, mods and update backups.
